name: 품사 태그 분포
description: 분석합니다 품사 tag 분포 패턴 감지하기 위해 AI 생성 text, 는 often shows unnatural grammatical structure 분포s.
useCase: Detecting AI text through abnormal grammatical category 분포s compared to natural 인간 글쓰기
mechanism: 수행합니다 품사 tagging on input text and computes the frequency 분포 of each POS category (nouns, verbs, adjectives, adverbs, etc.). AI 생성 text tends to over-rely on certain syntactic constructions, producing flatter 분포s or unusual ratios 사이의 categories (e.g., higher adjective-to-noun ratio). The method compares observed 분포s against reference human corpora using chi-squared goodness-of-fit tests.
source: Fröhling & Zubiaga (2021) - Feature-based Detection of Automated Language Models: Tackling GPT-2, GPT-3, and Grover, PeerJ Computer Science
algorithm: POS Tagging + Chi-Squared Goodness-of-Fit + KL Divergence
parameters: POS Tagset: Universal Dependencies, Window: full document, Comparison: reference corpus baselines, Granularity: fine-grained 36-tag
strengths:
• Language-structure based rather than content-based
• Works 에 걸친 different AI model architectures
• 계산 효율적
• Interpretable results for linguists
limitations:
• Requires sufficient text length for reliable statistics
• May vary 에 걸친 text genres and domains
• Advanced AI models increasingly mimic human POS 분포s
• Less effective on short texts (<100 words)
